scenes.text: Before you pay anywhere in Korea, ask this.
It means: do you take card? Most places do, but small stalls sometimes don't.
Use it at street stalls, markets and taxis.
scenes.label: Say it at

caption:
Ask this before you pay anywhere in Korea 💳
카드 돼요? (ka-deu dwae-yo) = do you take card? Most places do, but some street stalls and market stands don't.
Save this for your trip.
